discovery.summary: Check a Pennsylvania registered county against caller policy
discovery.description: Resolve a Pennsylvania business name to one strong registry entity and compare its source-published registered county with caller-supplied allowedCounties. Returns policy_match, policy_mismatch, company_not_found, or human_review. The result evaluates only the supplied registered-county policy and does not prove physical operations, headquarters, service area, residency, local ownership, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Resolve a Pennsylvania business to one strong registry entity and compare its source-published registered county with a caller-supplied Pennsylvania county allowlist. Returns policy_match, policy_mismatch, company_not_found, or human_review. This is a caller-defined workflow policy check only; it does not prove physical operations, headquarters location, service area, residency, local ownership, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal compliance.

buyer.task: Resolve a Pennsylvania business to one strong registry entity and compare its source-published registered county with a caller-supplied allowed Pennsylvania county set.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independently verified external settled purchases and repeat demand; do not treat synthetic fixtures, public discovery or HTTP 200 as sales.
